caseName: National Council Junior Order United American Mechanics v. Nicodemus
caseNameFull: National Council Junior Order United American Mechanics v. Catherine A. Nicodemus
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Colorado.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726. Mr. George P. Steele for plaintiff in error. Mr. Fred Herrington, Mr. William D. Wright ánd Mr. William D. Wright, Jr., for defendant in error.
